Name: (CP) Ore Crops and Geode Tree
Author: Donnie24
Description:
[size=4]About the mod:[/size]
Are you tired of mining the whole day for a handful of ores? Don't you like killing monsters? Do you like to take care of your plants and harvest everything that grows on your farm?

Now you can grow your own resources (including money) with seven new crops and there is also a geode tree!

The crops will produce the vanilla base game items. Normally they don't have quality, but these do. So you need five ores of the same quality for the furnace to produce a bar, the quality of the coal doesn't matter.

There is a readme in the zip-file how to purchase the seeds. There is a small mistake in the readme, sorry for that.  Please read the article.

The mod is in English and German, translations are welcome.

An additional mod using PFM for the seedmaker will come soon.


[size=4]How to install:[/size]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
3. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it into your mods folder

If you want to remove this mod,  just delete it from your mods folder. Any items still left in your inventory will become error items, which can be thrown away.


[size=4]Art permission:[/size]
With permission I used [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mizus-sprites.136549/]Mizu's Custom Crop Sprites[/url] for the new crop sprites and the seeds packages follow the same color scheme from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21442]Standardized Seasonal Seed Sprites mod[/url].
